name: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd
title: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd - 544149 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue fell ~12% YoY to INR364.94 cr on deliberate bid discipline; no capacity or supply signal, FY27 guided to 20%+ growth with working capital stretched by loans and advances of INR146.45 cr.

triggers.label: Loans and advances INR146.45 cr
triggers.quote: Our loan and advances stood at approximately INR146.45 crores as on March '26, and we expect that this will be reduced meaningfully in the near term

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth upwards of 20%
triggers.quote: we are targeting upwards of 20% revenue growth on a consolidated basis

triggers.label: Q4 revenue down ~12% YoY
triggers.quote: nearly 12% year-on-year decline. So, this was a conscious outcome of our disciplined approach to bidding

guidance.quote: we are targeting upwards of 20% revenue growth on a consolidated basis
We are targeting to scale this qualification to 800 to 1,000 tons per day over the next 18 months

red_flags.label: Receivables and loans up; Q4 revenue down 12% YoY
red_flags.quote: our working capital, specifically receivables and loans and advances, has increased during the year

red_flags.label: Government tender decisions delayed, spillover into next year
red_flags.quote: the decisions are pending. It could come any time a little later

evasions.quote: I will not be able to give you a 2-, 3-year guidance
currently, there is no fixed commercial cost that can be allotted because these are all under pilot
